---
title: "quarto-term"
subtitle: "Persistent terminal sessions in Quarto"
format: revealjs
engine: markdown
extensions:
  term:
    shell: zsh
    init:
      - zsh-syntax-highlighting
      - "setopt INTERACTIVE_COMMENTS"
    style:
      colorscheme: nord
      cols: 64
---

## Hello, terminal!

```{term}
echo 'Hello from a RevealJS slide!'
```

## State persists across slides

```{term}
export GREETING="quarto-term is amazing"
```

```{term}
echo $GREETING | cowsay
```

## Colors and formatting

```{term}
for i ({0..15}) { print -nP "%K{$i} ${(l:2:)i} %k"; ((i%8==7))&&print }
```

## Interactive commands

```{term}
sleep 100 #! expect-prompt: false
ctrl-c #! literal: false, delay: 0.5
echo 'Back to the prompt!'
```
